records.key: A lit window in the dark: warm orange on near-black, a field of luminous points behind it, and a sound set in G minor at 118 BPM.
records.source: A lit window in the dark: warm orange on near-black, a field of luminous points behind it, and a sound set in G minor at 118 BPM.
records.translation: Une fenêtre éclairée dans l’obscurité : orange chaud sur un fond presque noir, un champ de points lumineux derrière et un ensemble sonore en sol mineur à 118 BPM.

records.key: A teal horizon line with currents of light bending above it, and a sound set in A Dorian at 124 BPM.
records.source: A teal horizon line with currents of light bending above it, and a sound set in A Dorian at 124 BPM.
records.translation: Une ligne d’horizon turquoise avec des courants de lumière qui se courbent au-dessus et un ensemble de sons en la dorien à 124 BPM.

records.key: The last colour in the sky: plum and dusty rose, currents of light moving overhead, and a soft sound set in E flat minor at 114 BPM.
records.source: The last colour in the sky: plum and dusty rose, currents of light moving overhead, and a soft sound set in E flat minor at 114 BPM.
records.translation: La dernière couleur du ciel : prune et rose poudré, des courants de lumière qui se déplacent au-dessus et un ensemble de sons doux en mi bémol mineur à 114 BPM.

records.key: The long low light of a year's turn: olive and pale gold, luminous points through it, and a sound set in G Lydian at 112 BPM.
records.source: The long low light of a year's turn: olive and pale gold, luminous points through it, and a sound set in G Lydian at 112 BPM.
records.translation: La lumière longue et basse du tournant de l’année : olive et or pâle, des points lumineux parmi ces teintes et ensemble sonore en sol lydien à 112 BPM.
